Google Sheet & Drive Bridge

Live webhook endpoint for real-time cloud append

How to Connect Live Google Sheet:

  1. Open Google Sheet > Extensions > Apps Script.
  2. Paste the provided CelcomDigi Apps Script code.
  3. Deploy as Web App (Access: Anyone).
  4. Paste the generated Web App URL below and save!

Leave blank to use robust local offline storage.

// CelcomDigi MPL Event Apps Script Webhook
function doPost(e) {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getActiveSheet();
  var data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
  if (data.action === "ADD_SUBMISSION") {
    var row = [
      new Date(),
      data.date,
      data.fullName,
      "'" + data.icNumber,
      "'" + data.contact,
      "'" + data.gameId,
      "'" + data.serverId,
      data.plan,
      "'" + data.newNumber,
      data.freeDiamond,
      data.submittedBy
    ];
    ss.appendRow(row);
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status: "success"}))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
}
